sar.narrative: This report details suspicious online activity involving customer C03633 and their card C03633-K1. On November 25, 2016, between 21:00:00 and 21:21:00, four online transactions were conducted in rapid succession. The transactions were for $488.31, $489.91, $479.33, and $477.74, totaling $1,935.29. The final transaction was traced to a MacOS device running Chrome 49.0. This activity is highly suspicious because the card is historically used almost exclusively for in-person transactions, with only 4 out of 108 prior purchases occurring online. Furthermore, the transaction amounts are all just under $500, indicating a deliberate attempt to evade standard authorization thresholds. The transaction amounts also fall within the top 3% of the cardholder's typical purchase history. Due to the rapid succession of high-value, out-of-character online purchases designed to avoid detection, a suspicious activity report is being filed.
